title: Remote foundations M6: bounded operator pilot — A central, MacBookPro satellite, explicitly enabled, with a reconnect/restart/disable matrix
outcome: Remote foundations M6: bounded operator pilot — A central, MacBookPro satellite, explicitly enabled, with a reconnect/restart/disable matrix
acceptance: With exact build identities on both hosts and the capability explicitly enabled by Greg, delivery, wake and processing between a session on A and a session on the Mac satellite are verified separately through the central host.

A reconnect/restart/disable matrix passes: disable drains or freezes pending intents visibly and preserves logs, cursors and dedup; uncertain operations are preserved; rollback never drops unknown schema or outbox data.
Operator relay is retired as the primary route only after this passes; any host restart, install or SSH change in the pilot is Greg's own act.
